advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: After you move the text, examine the file size.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md line 71, a paragraph gives steps in a sequence (examine the file size, move sections, move the largest section first, stop, add a warning), not a numbered list.
advisory.correction: "After you move the text, do these steps: 1. Examine the file size. 2. If the file is more than a limit in "When you examine the file size", move more sections that have a specified condition. Move the largest section first. 3. When the file is not more than each limit, stop. 4. If the file is still more than a limit, add a warning. (advisory)"
